## What's new in 1.21.2

- Fixed: in a contact's notes, the text cursor could jump back and a space could disappear while typing. Thanks to the Reddit user who reported it.

## Also included from 1.21.1

1.21.1 was not released on its own, so its changes come with this version:

- The spaces and budget categories created with your account now follow the language you choose, as long as you haven't renamed them.
- When you create a theme, panel opacity now goes from 0 to 100% and glass blur up to 60 px. If some text may be hard to read, Aqueli shows a warning but lets you keep your choice.

## Install

Download `Aqueli_1.21.2_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs Aqueli for your Windows user account, without administrator rights, and keeps your data from the previous version.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
